rules.coins: 1 CP = 1/100 GP; 1 SP = 1/10 GP; 1 EP = 1/2 GP; 1 GP = 1 GP; 1 PP = 10 GP. 50 coins weigh 1 lb. Selling equipment: half cost when sold; gems, trade goods, and art retain full value.
rules.heavy: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it is a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it is a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13. (2024 PHB p. 213 — NOT the 2014 Small/Tiny rule.)
rules.cleave: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn. (2024 PHB p. 214.)
rules.armorStrength: If the table shows a Strength score in the Strength column for an armor type, that armor reduces the wearer's speed by 10 feet unless the wearer has a Strength score equal to or higher than the listed score. (2024 PHB p. 219.)
rules.ammunition: Ammunition is expended on use. Loading weapons need a free hand to load. A ranged weapon in melee has Disadvantage on attack rolls within 5 ft of a hostile creature that can see you and isn't Incapacitated. NOTE (Flag 1, item-1 ruling 2026-10-29): the book's half-back recovery rule is NOT used — recovery is scavenging as part of the looting scene, with ammo spent tracked per encounter.
rules.attunement: Max 3 items at a time; can't attune to more than one copy of an item; attuning takes a Short Rest focused on only that item while in physical contact.

_meta.source: 2024 PHB Equipment Chapter 6 (pp. 213–233), parent-verified transcription 2026-11-07. Book wins on conflict.
_meta.money: costCp is integer copper pieces (1 GP = 100 CP). cost/costGp kept for existing readers.
correctionsApplied: Heavy = Disadvantage unless Str 13 (melee) or Dex 13 (ranged), NOT Small/Tiny.
Cleave = second attack roll; second creature takes the WEAPON'S DAMAGE (no ability mod unless negative), once per turn.
Druidic Focus has THREE entries only (Sprig of Mistletoe, Wooden Staff, Yew Wand) — NO Totem (2014 holdover).
Armor Strength rule: Str below the listed score reduces speed by 10 ft.
Lance 1d10 Heavy/Reach/Two-Handed Topple; Trident 1d8 versatile 1d10; Warhammer 5 lb; War Pick Versatile 1d10.
Padded NO stealth disadvantage; Studded Leather HAS stealth disadvantage.
Priest's Pack 33 GP; Rope 5 lb; Camel capacity 450 lb.
Net is adventuring gear only, NOT a weapon. Musket/Pistol/Firearm Bullets/Map/Spell Scrolls/String/Feed/Stabling/Airship added.
All 7 packs rebuilt to 2024 contents + weights. All 10 instruments + 11 focuses priced + weighed.
_meta.extrasNote: Bank-only 2014 items kept as named extras — NOT chapter items, NOT 2024 prices. Do not present them as chapter items.
_meta.unverifiedCarryover: Mount speeds (p. 229 table as transcribed lists carrying capacity + cost only) and tack extras are carried over from the 2014 bank, not chapter-verified.
_meta.countNote: COUNT FLAG: the brief and the transcription header say '37 weapons' and '13 armor + shield', but the enumerated chapter tables contain 38 weapons (10 simple melee + 4 simple ranged + 18 martial melee + 6 martial ranged) and 12 armor (3 light + 5 medium + 4 heavy) + Shield. This file encodes the ENUMERATED tables (38 weapons, 12 armor + Shield); the header figures look like miscounts. See staging note. Setting weapons (2026-11-08): +3 setting weapons (Yklwa, Double-Bladed Scimitar, Hoopak) — 38 chapter + 3 setting = 41 weapons in this file.
_meta.pagesNotPhotographed: pp. 216–218 were not photographed (likely weapons/armor art spread). No rule or table in this file is sourced from those pages.
_meta.flag1: Book ammunition half-back recovery rule (1 minute, recover half used, round down) is deliberately NOT encoded. Item-1 ruling (Zach, 2026-10-29): recovery is scavenging as part of the looting scene, NO automatic half-back.
